# Nasq project instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root.
For UI work, follow `DESIGN.md`, `apps/web/AGENTS.md`, `docs/design-system/components.md` and `docs/agents/frontend-theme.md`.
